aioa.midnightconfig.hostile_spawn_settin: Only actual hostile mobs are suppressed by default. Villagers, animals, and other non-hostile AI mobs stay active unless another mod changes how they classify themselves.
aioa.midnightconfig.hostile_nullificatio: Apply hostile nullification in the Overworld only
aioa.midnightconfig.ignore_special_spawn: Ignore special or scripted hostile spawns
aioa.midnightconfig.day_spawn_settings_c: Configured mobs in the AIOA day pool can spawn on the surface during the day. Spawn entries use the format entity_id;enabled=true;weight=10;chance=1.0;min=1;max=3.
aioa.midnightconfig.day_spawns_overworld: Apply day surface spawns in the Overworld only
aioa.midnightconfig.prevent_sunlight_bur: Prevent sunlight burn for AIOA day spawns
